_about: 2-Propanol (1) + n-Heptane (2): isothermal total pressures at 483.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 2-propanol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: B. C. Oh, S. Lee, J. Seo, H. Kim, Isothermal Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for the 2-Propanol + n-Heptane System near the Critical Region, J. Chem. Eng. Data 49 (2004) 221-223
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
